implementation_overlay: Pre-existing 50 GiB guard-default working-tree changes are retained. Exact file hashes below, not the commit alone, bind the executed overlay.
retry_reason: Restart-only protocol revision. The shared candidate was trained under v2 and private/gradient-cut under v3; restart and scoring now validate each candidate against its declared historical protocol while pinning their own current implementation. All training evidence is reused and no new training is run.

shared.compatibility: Accepted shared training and same-process image evidence. Only restart/scorer baseline validation changed.

private.compatibility: Accepted private training and same-process private-image evidence. Only restart/scorer baseline validation changed.

gradient_cut.compatibility: Completed gradient-cut control evidence. Only scorer baseline validation changed.

purpose: Complete fresh-process restart and the paired M3 verdict for preserved shared/private/gradient-cut candidates using different per-depth write proposals, identical observations and matched writer/reader parameters. No additional training or capacity-matched/fresh-audit superiority claim.
hypothesis: The accepted shared and private candidates can reload their exact extension and authenticated depth images in fresh processes and reproduce correct held-out answers without observation encoding; the independent scorer can validate all historical arms under explicit protocol aliases.
parent_role: Historical E2 initialization reference only; no new parent load or training in this protocol.

dataset.role: Previously exposed M2 synthetic diagnostic reused for ownership regression. It is not a fresh capability audit and must not train a selector or support a generalization claim.

depth_contract.writers: Two independent SGDN-2 write encoders at blocks 13 and 27 in every historical arm; identical frozen input-token embeddings and source pages, matched writer/reader parameter counts.
depth_contract.shared: For each observation chunk, evaluate both next-state proposals independently against one chunk-start state and publish their equal-weight convex mean once. This is a project reducer, not uTTT gradient aggregation.
depth_contract.private: Apply each depth's proposal to its own state at the same chunk boundaries; both depths received every observation. Two logical state matrices are retained.
depth_contract.gradient_cut: Shared reducer with every depth's first observation write detached. Later observation writes remain differentiable. Diagnostic control only.
depth_contract.read_schedule: Two observation chunks were committed before each delayed query. Query, answer, generated continuation and future observations never enter writes.
depth_contract.state_accounting: Shared and gradient-cut retain one 65536-byte FP32 matrix; private retains two for 131072 bytes. State capacity is deliberately unequal and no capacity-normalized superiority claim is permitted.
depth_contract.compute_accounting: Every historical M3 arm performed two observation encodings and two SGDN-2 transition evaluations per chunk, and two readers per action pass. Optimizer state, trainable FP32 bytes, wall time, sampled memory and artifacts are measured.

training.feature_producer: Frozen native input-token embeddings of observed pages; per-depth writers trained, original backbone remained frozen.
training.write_schedule: Two observation chunks per case; no target or future text in writes.
training.optimizer_state: Int8 Muon momentum; trainable parameters and gradients FP32; auxiliary AdamW groups and state FP32. Actual allocated state was recorded after the final update.
training.loss: Response-only next-token cross entropy on answer plus EOS; prompt prefix masked.
training.selection: Empty record bank; only committed fast state supplies observations.
training.retention_replay: Two fixed retention cases evaluated before and after candidate training; no additional model copy. Retention is measured and reported but is not an acceptance gate in this protocol.

evaluation.metric: Exact stripped answer; preserve raw token IDs, answers, correctness and paired case identities.
evaluation.correction: All eight dev+held-out corrections; changed state and independently corrected expected answer where appropriate.
evaluation.same_process_restart: Historical candidates saved and reloaded actual shared/private depth images with all tensors, stable component version, owner/scope, lineage and counters; no observation re-encoding.
evaluation.fresh_process_restart: Launch run_m3_restart.py for shared and private in new native processes. Reload extension and image and answer held-out case one without observation encoding.
evaluation.cross_arm_verdict: score_m3_depth.py validates both accepted arms, gradient-cut, fresh restarts, baseline_arms aliases, implementation/data pins, matched parameter/compute fields and all budgets; paired answers and metrics are descriptive.

decision_rule.per_arm_accept: Correct held-out exact accuracy strictly above linear, shuffled, zero and disabled, dev not below disabled, update-two first/later gradients nonzero for every depth, finite gradients, and state/lineage/answer reload checks pass.
decision_rule.gradient_cut_accept: At update two, every first-chunk write has no gradient and every later per-depth write has finite nonzero gradient. Quality outcome does not promote this control.
decision_rule.cross_arm_accept: Both shared and private pass per-arm acceptance and fresh-process restart; gradient-cut and all protocol, implementation, resource and artifact checks pass. Otherwise defer and diagnose.
decision_rule.comparison: Do not require answer equality because depth proposals differ. Do not claim shared superiority, capacity-normalized benefit or fresh generalization from the exposed family.
decision_rule.no_promotion: All M3 outputs are diagnostic_only. Private runtime dispatch/promotion is not admitted by this experiment.

stop_conditions: wall-time, token, generation or artifact budget exceeded
source, target, future or unexpected producer content enters writes
dataset, parent, protocol or implementation hash mismatch
missing per-depth gradient coverage or private state inventory
unauthenticated image/lineage or stale candidate restart
retention: Keep all extensions, depth images, raw prompts/answers, gradient probes, optimizer audits, failures, guard traces and comparison output. No base copy, download, remote push or default publication.
claims: M3 ownership and delayed-use engineering on an exposed synthetic family. No state-matched superiority, uTTT reproduction, broad memory, RSI, personal fidelity or production private-runtime claim.
